description: This file defines the abstract base class 'Template' for compiled Twig templates, including methods for rendering, block management, and template inheritance.

classes.name: Twig\Template
classes.description: Abstract base class for compiled Twig templates, providing methods for rendering, block management, and template inheritance.

methods.name: getTemplateName
methods.description: Returns the name of the template.

methods.name: getDebugInfo
methods.description: Returns debug information about the template.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Returns information about the original template source code.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent template, if any.

methods.name: doGetParent
methods.description: Internal method to determine the parent template.

methods.name: isTraitable
methods.description: Indicates whether the template can be used as a trait.

methods.name: displayParentBlock
methods.description: Displays a parent block.

methods.name: displayBlock
methods.description: Displays a block.

methods.name: renderParentBlock
methods.description: Renders a parent block as a string.

methods.name: renderBlock
methods.description: Renders a block as a string.

methods.name: hasBlock
methods.description: Checks if a block exists in the current context.

methods.name: getBlockNames
methods.description: Returns all block names in the current context.

methods.name: loadTemplate
methods.description: Loads a template by name or object.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Returns the template instance itself.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Returns all blocks defined in the template.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the template with the given context.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the template to a string.

methods.name: yield
methods.description: Generator that yields parts of the rendered template.

methods.name: yieldBlock
methods.description: Generator that yields a specific block.

methods.name: yieldParentBlock
methods.description: Generator that yields a parent block.

methods.name: hasMacro
methods.description: Checks if a macro exists.

methods.name: getTemplateForMacro
methods.description: Finds the template where a macro is defined.

methods.name: doDisplay
methods.description: Abstract method to display the template content.
